title: When Effects run relative to paint

slides.say: Usually Effects run after the browser paints. But clicks change that.

slides.text: Not caused by an interaction? React generally lets the browser paint first.
slides.say: If the Effect was not caused by an interaction, React generally lets the browser paint the screen first, then runs it.

slides.text: Caused by a click? React may run the Effect BEFORE paint, so the event system can see its result.
slides.say: If it was caused by an interaction like a click, React may run the Effect before paint, so its result can be observed by the event system.
If work must wait until after paint, like an alert, wrap it in set timeout. And if you must block paint, use use layout effect instead.
